audit_status.source_base: Greek 1 Peter text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact draft reviewed for suffering in flesh, changed life, love covering, gifts/service, fiery testing, not suffering as wrongdoer.

verses.restored: Therefore, Messiah having suffered in flesh, you also arm yourselves with the same mind, because the one suffering in flesh has ceased from sin/misalignment,

familiar.text: Forasmuch then as Christ hath suffered for us in the flesh, arm yourselves likewise with the same mind: for he that hath suffered in the flesh hath ceased from sin;

verses.restored: so as to live the remaining time in flesh no longer for human desires but for will of Divine.

familiar.text: That he no longer should live the rest of his time in the flesh to the lusts of men, but to the will of God.

verses.restored: For enough is the time having passed to have worked the will of the nations, having walked in licentiousness, desires, drunkenness, revels, drinking parties, and unlawful idolatries.

familiar.text: For the time past of our life may suffice us to have wrought the will of the Gentiles, when we walked in lasciviousness, lusts, excess of wine, revellings, banquetings, and abominable idolatries:

verses.restored: In this they are surprised that you do not run together into the same flood of dissipation, and they blaspheme/slander.

familiar.text: Wherein they think it strange that ye run not with them to the same excess of riot, speaking evil of you:

verses.restored: They will give account to the One ready to judge living and dead.

familiar.text: Who shall give account to him that is ready to judge the quick and the dead.

verses.restored: For into this also the good news was announced to dead ones, so that they might be judged according to humans in flesh but live according to Divine in Spirit.

familiar.text: For for this cause was the gospel preached also to them that are dead, that they might be judged according to men in the flesh, but live according to God in the spirit.

verses.restored: But the end/goal of all things has drawn near; therefore be sound-minded and sober into prayers.

familiar.text: But the end of all things is at hand: be ye therefore sober, and watch unto prayer.

verses.restored: Before all things, having earnest love among yourselves, because love covers a multitude of sins/misalignments.

familiar.text: And above all things have fervent charity among yourselves: for charity shall cover the multitude of sins.

verses.restored: Be hospitable to one another without grumbling.

familiar.text: Use hospitality one to another without grudging.

verses.restored: As each received a grace-gift, serve it to one another as beautiful/good stewards of the many-colored grace of Divine.

familiar.text: As every man hath received the gift, even so minister the same one to another, as good stewards of the manifold grace of God.

verses.restored: If anyone speaks, as oracles of Divine; if anyone serves, as from strength that the Divine supplies, so that in all things the Divine may be glorified through Jesus Messiah, to whom is glory and dominion into the ages of the ages. Amen.

familiar.text: If any man speak, let him speak as the oracles of God; if any man minister, let him do it as of the ability which God giveth: that God in all things may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom be praise and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.

verses.restored: Beloved, do not be surprised at the fiery testing among you coming for your testing, as though a strange thing were happening to you,

familiar.text: Beloved, think it not strange concerning the fiery trial which is to try you, as though some strange thing happened unto you:

verses.restored: but as you share in the sufferings of Messiah, rejoice, so that also in unveiling of his glory you may rejoice exulting.

familiar.text: But rejoice, inasmuch as ye are partakers of Christ’s sufferings; that, when his glory shall be revealed, ye may be glad also with exceeding joy.

verses.restored: If you are reproached in name of Messiah, blessed are you, because the Spirit of glory and of the Divine rests upon you.

familiar.text: If ye be reproached for the name of Christ, happy are ye; for the spirit of glory and of God resteth upon you: on their part he is evil spoken of, but on your part he is glorified.

verses.restored: For let none of you suffer as murderer or thief or wrongdoer or meddler.

familiar.text: But let none of you suffer as a murderer, or as a thief, or as an evildoer, or as a busybody in other men’s matters.

verses.restored: But if as Messiah-person, let one not be ashamed, but glorify the Divine in this name.

familiar.text: Yet if any man suffer as a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify God on this behalf.

verses.restored: Because the season for judgment begins from the household of the Divine; and if first from us, what is the end of those disobeying the good news of the Divine?

familiar.text: For the time is come that judgment must begin at the house of God: and if it first begin at us, what shall the end be of them that obey not the gospel of God?

verses.restored: And if the righteous/just one is saved/healed with difficulty, where will the irreverent and sinner/misaligned appear?

familiar.text: And if the righteous scarcely be saved, where shall the ungodly and the sinner appear?

verses.restored: Therefore also let those suffering according to will of the Divine entrust their souls/lives to a trustworthy Creator in doing good.

familiar.text: Wherefore let them that suffer according to the will of God commit the keeping of their souls to him in well doing, as unto a faithful Creator.

safety_note: 1 Peter 4 does not glorify suffering or tell people to remain in abuse. It distinguishes unjust reproach from suffering as a wrongdoer and centers doing good, prayer, love, hospitality, and entrusting life to the faithful Creator.
translation_notes: Many-colored grace preserves poikilos grace imagery.
The good-news-to-dead passage requires second-pass audit; first draft preserves ambiguity.
